incidents.name: MBC and ZZSH transfer accounting flaw
incidents.notes: MBC's transfer path lets a caller reduce the liquidity pair's own token balance without sync(), and the same pattern in ZZSH, so the attacker skewed both reserves and swapped the imbalance out for USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: MBC 0x4E87880A72f6896E7e0a635A5838fFc89b13bd17 created 2022-07-30T14:14:32Z by 0x5c1c48821d3e0d5d2f05081e1a6507f2f9e8d51c, unrelated to attack sender 0x9cc3270de4a3948449c1a73eabff5d0275f60785; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attacker netted 5,904.37 USDT while 8,910.12 USDT left MBC and 1,525.55 USDT left ZZSH in the exploit transaction.
